title: A familiar HR partner needs employee data
scenario: Your usual HR business partner messages asking for a spreadsheet of employee home addresses for an urgent benefits mailing. They use the same friendly tone and reference a real project.

answers.A: Ask the HR partner to open the request in the standard HR/data process.
answers.B: Send it because the requester is someone you work with every week and the project is real.
answers.C: Verify the request and data-sharing need through an approved HR channel and send only via the authorized system if legitimate.

explanation: Compromised accounts and social engineering exploit real relationships. Sensitive employee data should follow process regardless of familiarity.
proTip: Familiar person, sensitive data: verify the request, not the tone.
